An adult with suspected sepsis has MAP 58, lactate 4.6, mottled skin after 1 L fluid. What is FIRST nursing action per 1-hour bundle?

संदिग्ध सेप्सिस वाले वयस्क में एमएपी 58, लैक्टेट 4.6, 1 एल तरल पदार्थ के बाद धब्बेदार त्वचा होती है। प्रति 1 घंटे के बंडल में प्रथम नर्सिंग कार्रवाई क्या है?
solution:
Correct Answer: (a) Sept­ic shock; FIRST draw blood cultures then broad-spectrum antibiotics within 1 hour plus 30 mL per kg crystalloids, norepinephrine for MAP above 65, lactate recheck, urine output, oxygen, source control. Concept: 1-hour bundle is cultures before antibiotics, antibiotics within 1 hour, fluids 30 mL per kg, vasopressor for hypotension, lactate guided resuscitation. The key words sept, shock, draw, blood point to this option as the FIRST priority. Why others are incorrect: 'Only antipyretic and wait till morning Monitor...' is incorrect because it delays definitive care and misses the FIRST priority 'Give high-dose steroids alone first Monitor vital...' is incorrect because it delays definitive care and misses the FIRST priority 'Stop all fluids and give diuretics Monitor...' is incorrect because it delays definitive care and misses the FIRST priority. Tip: Remember sept, shock, draw, blood as the key decision point for this condition.
